own_solution.law: Definition of linear momentum p = m v, so v = p / m = 0.5 / 0.05
assumptions: the stated momentum and mass are the values after the transfer event (final state)
velocity reported as magnitude along the direction of the momentum

notes: Added statement about object B is structurally disconnected (explicitly never interacts with A), so the answer is 10.0 m/s in all four renderings. Renderings differ only in B's speed (6, 9, 10, 14 m/s). Observation: in the third rendering B's speed (10.0 m/s) coincides numerically with the correct answer, which may confound any analysis of distractor-copying in that rendering; not a physics defect.
